content: Conversational forecasting. As described in Section SECREF1, prior work on forecasting conversational outcomes and events has largely relied on hand-crafted features to capture aspects of conversational dynamics. Example feature sets include statistical measures based on similarity between utterances BIBREF16, sentiment imbalance BIBREF20, flow of ideas BIBREF20, increase in hostility BIBREF8, reply rate BIBREF11 and graph representations of conversations BIBREF52, BIBREF17. By contrast, we aim to automatically learn neural representations of conversational dynamics through pre-training.
